chunks: Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who wishes to perform something of good, such as charity, fasting, and the like, he said: “It is recommended that that be on the day of al-Jumuʿah, for deeds on the day of al-Jumuʿah are multiplied.”

key_terms.الصَّدَقَةِ: charity given for the sake of Allah
key_terms.الصَّوْمِ: fasting as an act of worship
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, a specially virtuous day

ai.seo_question: Why is it recommended to perform charity and fasting on Friday in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that acts of goodness such as charity and fasting are recommended to be performed on the day of al-Jumuʿah. It highlights the special virtue of Friday by stating that deeds performed on that day are multiplied.
